basemaps.name: OpenFreeMap Bright (High-Contrast Vector Road Basemap)
basemaps.attribution: OpenFreeMap © OpenMapTiles Data from OpenStreetMap contributors
basemaps.description: High-contrast vector tile service optimized for clear road hierarchy, highway shields, and place labels with zero API key constraints.

basemaps.name: OpenStreetMap Standard (Raster Fallback)
basemaps.description: Public raster tile failover used for development and emergency fallback. Production deployments should utilize self-hosted tiles.

datasets.name: Global Protected Forest Reserves Dataset
datasets.source: Global Forest Watch, Protected Planet (WDPA), and OpenStreetMap
datasets.description: Curated geospatial coordinates, bounds, biomes, and conservation statuses for 268 primary forest reserves across 6 continents.

datasets.name: Global Zoological Parks and Conservation Centers
datasets.source: World Association of Zoos and Aquariums (WAZA), Wikidata & OpenStreetMap
datasets.description: Geolocated botanical and zoological conservation institutions indexed with road entrances and verified taxa collections.

datasets.name: Master Species & Verified Taxa Occurrences
datasets.source: GBIF (Global Biodiversity Information Facility) & IUCN Red List of Threatened Species
datasets.description: Taxonomic catalog with kingdom, phylum, class, order, family, conservation status, and verified habitat associations.
